posts.title: iBoot stage (main bootloader) security on macOS
posts.description: How iBoot on Apple Silicon Macs acts as the final secure gate before macOS launches by verifying signed boot assets, enforcing memory and hardware protections, validating the SSV, and making boot-level compromise significantly harder than attacks against the kernel or user space. The post iBoot stage (main bootloader) security on macOS appeared first on Olivia A. Gallucci .
